players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers remains on the IL with a hamate fracture. Surgery was performed May 19 and his expected return date is approximately July 3. MIN has been managing their catching duties in his absence.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 1-for-4 with a run scored in PHI's 3-0 shutout win over SDP. Continues to anchor PHI's lineup with 13 home runs and a .271 average through 50 games. Healthy and productive.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-3 with 2 RBI, pushing his batting average to .325. He remains among the NL leaders in batting average and has been one of the most consistent hitters in your lineup all season.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 1-for-4 with a run scored in NYM's win. Batting .218 on the season while providing steady production at third base. His counting stats (27 RBI, 24 R) remain strong.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle went 2-for-4 and scored a run in DET's 4-0 shutout win over LAA. The young shortstop continues to hold down the slot capably since replacing Lindor, hitting .195 with solid defense.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 1-for-4 with a run and an RBI. Still on pace for 35+ steals on the season with 11 SB through roughly 50 games. Remains CHC's most dynamic offensive threat.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill went 1-for-4 in SDP's 3-0 shutout loss to PHI. Batting .202 on the season, going through a tough stretch offensively. Still contributing with 9 SB and solid center field defense.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: INJURY UPDATE: Teoscar Hernández left Tuesday's game in the 2nd inning with a left hamstring strain after going 0-for-1. An MRI has been scheduled for May 28. He is expected to miss a minimum of 2 to 4 weeks. LAD will need to adjust their outfield rotation during his absence.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went 2-for-4 with a run and 3 RBI in NYY's win. Rice continues to provide solid production as the DH, proving to be an effective occupant of the Stanton slot with strong RBI production.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams worked a scoreless inning to earn his 9th save of the season, working around 3 walks with a strikeout. His season ERA has improved to 5.89 after a rough early stretch. 13 W+SV on the year.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: INJURY UPDATE: Cole Ragans suffered a setback during his IL rehab assignment for pitcher's elbow (VEO). He has been on the IL since May 8 and the return timeline is now uncertain following the setback. KCR will continue to monitor his recovery before scheduling a return.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns pitched on May 26 and was not scheduled today. He continues to have a breakout season with a 2.08 ERA over 65.0 IP across 11 starts, making him one of your top fantasy assets this year.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi last started on May 23 and lines up for his next start around May 28-29. He has been consistent this season with a 3.67 ERA over 68.67 IP in 11 starts, providing steady innings for your staff.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was not scheduled on May 27. The LAD righty holds a 4.71 ERA over 51.67 IP in 10 starts this season, pitching to contact and logging quality innings for a deep LAD rotation.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was not scheduled on May 27. The LAA lefty leads your pitching staff in strikeouts with 80 K through 12 starts, though his 4.87 ERA reflects a tough run-support environment in Anaheim.

injuries.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
injuries.note: Ryan Jeffers had surgery May 19; expected return ~July 3.

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Left May 27 game in 2nd inning; MRI scheduled May 28; minimum 2-4 weeks out.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Suffered setback during rehab assignment; return timeline uncertain.
